bio.text: Darren Soto represents Florida's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and is from Kissimmee, Florida.
He was elected to the Florida House of Representatives in a 2007 special election and served there until 2012.

Born in Ringwood, New Jersey, he earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Rutgers University in 2000 and a law degree from George Washington University in 2004, and was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2005.
